ModMetadata.Name: StationeersUIMod
ModMetadata.Author: FlorpyDorp + JXSN
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Stationeers UI Mod[/h1]
Radial inventory and HUD overhaul for Stationeers (procedural Unity UGUI radials + ImGui HUD). Toolbelt, tool, bag radials, SmartStow+, visor HUD, equipment keys. Client-side optional mod. [h3]POC integrated as Unity mod base[/h3]
ModMetadata.InGameDescription:
Stationeers UI Mod WARNING: This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad.
Stationeers UI Mod — Radials for tools/bags, SmartStow+, two-hand visor HUD. Replaces hotbar friction with modern interaction while keeping physical inventory rules.

Ported from BepInEx proof-of-concept into Unity mod project. Radials are now drawn with a fully procedural Unity UGUI renderer (code-built canvas + runtime mesh wedges).
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: [h3]Version 0.3.0:[/h3] [list] [*] Option A control schema (F10-switchable vs classic Option D): STOW wedges, device-control child radials with scroll-wheel value adjust, take/open satellites on nested bags, auto-close after actions [*] Search all bags: type-to-filter panel; click puts the item in a free hand or drops it at your feet [*] Drag-out parking: press-drag items out of radials onto the screen, drop them into slots, or RMB-out to drop them all [*] Radial editor (F10): black-screen playground with live example radials; every colour, font, size and thickness tunable [*] Full wedge outlines with side borders, wedge gaps and side-edge anti-aliasing; bold RBNo font; live state under icons (battery %, kPa, stack counts) [*] Custom UIA sorting classes (22 classes for 785 items) replace the game's coarse groups in bag radials [/list] [h3]Version 0.2.0:[/h3] [list] [*] Rebased as StationeersUIMod Unity/SLP mod (namespace StationeersUIMod) [*] Procedural Unity UGUI radial renderer (built in code, no prefabs) as primary [*] Hooked to SLP OnLoaded entrypoint; legacy ImGui painter retained for reference [*] All BepInEx plugin code integrated, patches preserved (fail-soft) [/list]
